author: Cleo Abram
description:
Have you heard the real story of these ancient scrolls?

When Mount Vesuvius erupted, it completely entombed the cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum, turning 1800 scrolls into blocks of charcoal. 

Now, researchers have finally found a way to read what’s inside all without ever unrolling a single scroll. To find out how, subscribe!

#pompeii #vesuvius #herculaneum #scrolls #AI
title: The Real Story of these Ancient Scrolls
